descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 87m², located on Rruga Ndue Përlleshi, in the EVERGREEN complex, built by Vëllezërit Asllani.

The apartment is on the 1st floor, in a building with two elevators, and has a functional floor plan for family living. The space consists of a living room with kitchen and a separate dining area, two bedrooms, one bathroom, one WC and a balcony.

The apartment has electric underfloor heating and is located in a quiet setting, with a dedicated space for children and good access to the main parts of the city. Markets, schools and other services needed for everyday life are nearby.

The apartment has an ownership certificate and the sale contract is signed at the notary.
The price of the property is €140,000, with one garage included.
On request, a second garage can also be purchased by agreement.
